statement: The xpad XboxOne FF_RUMBLE translation explicitly zeroes both trigger motor magnitudes while mapping ordinary strong/weak amplitudes to the main motors.

applicability.revision: standard Series identity where named; Elite and other revisions excluded
applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only: xpad.c:1600-1615. A uinput xpad-equivalent surface does not expose independent native impulse-trigger effects; no claim that hardware lacks those motors.
